entities.summary: Ryszard Parulski was a Polish fencer. He won a silver medal in the team foil event at the 1964 Summer Olympics and a bronze in the same event at the 1968 Summer Olympics. He also won gold medals at the 1961 World Fencing Championships and 1963 World Fencing Championships.
